# Pow square fixture

`ort127_pow_square.bin` is generated by
`trueos-kokoro-scalar/tools/generate_source_op_audit.py` using official ONNX
Runtime 1.27.0 with CPUExecutionProvider, graph optimization disabled, and one
thread. Its adjacent JSON file records the complete provenance and SHA-256.
Regeneration with ONNX Runtime 1.28.0 produced a byte-identical payload; 1.27.0
remains the stable fixture authority.

The fixture exercises the pinned FLOAT `Pow(x, 2.0)` specialization over a
rank-three tensor, including negative zero. The binary header is `<8s2I>` with
magic `KPOW1271`, version, and element count, followed by input then output
little-endian float32 words.
